I couldn't find a night-dispatch contact for Driftmoor anywhere I can see. The Coastal notes mention that Driftmoor's night dispatcher got a manifest CSV patch, but they don't name anyone. Kwame would know who it is, so it's worth asking him directly.

The only "Hector" in the notes is the night dispatcher at Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which is a different account, so I wouldn't use him for this.
